title: Paginate the order list
body:
The order list returns every order at once.

## Requirements

- FR-1: The order list returns at most 20 orders per page.
- FR-2: A `page` parameter selects the page, starting at 1.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1: Given 45 orders, when page 3 is requested, then 5 orders are returned (covers FR-1, FR-2)
- AC-2: Given 45 orders, when no page is given, then the first 20 orders are returned (covers FR-1)
